integrity: The universal Nijenhuis identity and induced deformation are proved by direct symbolic cancellation. Finite-field enumeration checks every matrix in several small dimensions, verifies deformation-fiber sizes, rank distributions, and the source's square-zero Rota-Baxter sublocus.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only the functional associative pre-Lie family x dot y = phi(x)y with phi nonzero.
It does not classify automorphism-conjugacy orbits of all Nijenhuis endomorphisms.
Later complete low-dimensional complex classifications already cover the corresponding two- and three-dimensional specializations.
title: Functional pre-Lie algebras are Nijenhuis-saturated
